values.note: recreation.gov rules: 14 nights in any rolling 30 days; a 3-night minimum over holiday weekends. Every site is reservable; the calendar opens April 15.

note: USACE campground on two wooded points on the east shore of Milford Lake: loop A (electric) on the north point, loop B (non-electric) on the south point. Loop A's west-rim sites (about A020-A030) are on the outer side of the loop road with open grass to the shore. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + live catalog: 51 sites (46 electric, 5 non-electric RV), 50 A at the five pull-throughs A001-A005 (live, not just cached), 30 A elsewhere, water; rates $14/$22/$24 (high 22 -> 24); showers; 14-in-30 max, 3-night holiday minimum. Lakefront stands on loop A's west rim; pin = catalog centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakefront' stands: imagery (2026-11-06, 140 m frame) shows loop A's west-rim sites (catalog A020-A030) on the lake side of the loop road, 15-30 m from the shoreline across open grass and riprap with no road or day use between; B002 on the south point is similar. rec.gov's catalog carries no 'Proximity to Water' tags. The interior and north-east A sites (A006-A018, A033-A046) are wooded and back from the water.
PIN 39.151,-96.9076 equals the live catalog centroid (39.15100,-96.90762); fine.
AMPERAGE checked live: A001-A005 carry 50 A in the live search API (A005 is the accessible one; A001-A004 are ordinary bookable sites), so 50 stands; the rest are 30 A.
SITE COUNT: rec.gov's description says 'Of the 59 cap sites'; the live catalog has 51 (no group or tent sites), so 51 kept.
MAX RIG not written: the catalog posts no driveway or equipment lengths (RV and Trailer permitted at 0 ft = unstated).
SEASON not written: the calendar offers nothing Nov-Mar and opens 2027-04-15, and the only rate season is April 15-September 30; no page states the campground's season.
